answer: Metered task-pulse admission. A seat enters through the harbor, a public pool of fresh tasks, and must solve 12 of them, assigned by hashing its own key so no two seats get the same set. 3 random reviewers from the knoll, the seats with a clean 20-epoch record, re-check 2 of the 12. Each epoch a pulse of 12 new tasks is needed to stay active. A farm of 500 fakes must therefore produce 6,000 real solutions every epoch, paid even if no review ever flags one.
